insight: Bret Taylor's startup hit a $10B valuation and $100M ARR within about 18 months of its 2024 founding.
name: Sierra
tagline: Enterprise AI agents for customer experience across channels.
description: An enterprise platform ('Agent OS') for building conversational AI agents that take action for customers across chat, voice, email, SMS, and WhatsApp. Supports both no-code and programmatic agent development. Founded by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor and used across a large share of the Fortune 500.

modelSupport.notes: Blends models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta per task.

changelog.summary: Recategorized from agent to the new support category for customer-support agents.

edge: Outcome-based pricing — you pay per successful resolution, not per seat — across chat, voice, email, SMS, and WhatsApp.
pros: Pay per resolved outcome, not flat seats
Omnichannel: chat, voice, email, SMS, WhatsApp
cons: Plus setup fees in the tens of thousands
Outcome definitions are negotiated and can drift

references.title: Bret Taylor's Sierra reaches $100M ARR in under two years
